segments.he: אֲבָל הַמְגַפֵּף וְהַמְנַשֵּׁק, הַמְכַבֵּד וְהַמְרַבֵּץ כּוּ׳. כִּי אֲתָא רַב דִּימִי, אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: עַל כּוּלָּם לוֹקֶה, חוּץ מֵהַנּוֹדֵר בִּשְׁמוֹ וְהַמְקַיֵּים בִּשְׁמוֹ.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «But» with regard to «one who hugs» an idol, «or one who kisses» it, «or one who cleans» it, «or one who sprays» water before it, he transgresses a prohibition but is not liable to receive capital punishment. «When Rav Dimi came» from Eretz Yisrael to Babylonia, he said that «Rabbi Elazar says: For all of» these actions one «is flogged, with the exception» of the cases stated later in the mishna «of one who vows in» an idol’s «name and one who affirms» his statement by an oath «in its name.»
